description: Refresh one or all enabled external .ics calendars on demand so newly added launches or events appear on the calendar right away (Studio and Pro).

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: One external calendar id from calendars_list to refresh. Leave out to refresh every enabled external calendar.

name: calendars_external_sync
title: Refresh external calendars
